scripts.text: [Falcon Flute Trader]

Do you need a Falcon?
With a magical Flute, you can call your Falcon from anywhere!

[Falcon Flute Trader]
It's marvelous, isn't it? Ha ha ha!

[Falcon Flute Trader]
Why I'm selling these Falcon Flutes?
It's because I have no clue how they work.
Ha ha ha!

[Falcon Flute Trader]
Of course, you'll need the Skill ^ff0000Falcon Mastery^000000.
I don't have the Skill, so I don't know how to handle Falcons.
As it's for now, I may never have a Falcon.

[Falcon Flute Trader]
But I can't give you one for free!
I have to make money since i also need to eat!

[Falcon Flute Trader]
If you need a Falcon Flute I will sell them for 12,500 zeny. Or is that too expensive?

[Falcon Flute Trader]
For Rangers, however, I have a special price of 10,000 zeny!
Don't buy one
Buy a Falcon Flute

[Falcon Flute Trader]
That's too bad. If you need one, come back!

[Falcon Flute Trader]
As I can see you already have a Falcon Flute!
Don't worry, my young friend, once you've purchased the Falcon Flute you won't need to do so again
since the Falcon Flute won't disappear upon usage, isn't that great?

[Falcon Flute Trader]
Here, take this flute.
With it you can whistle for your Falcon from anywhere.

[Falcon Flute Trader]
Just a reminder.
You need the Skill ^ff0000Falcon Mastery^000000 in order to use it!

[Falcon Flute Trader]
I'm sorry but you don't have enough money to buy a Falcon Flute, please come back when you have more money!

Hello, young one!
Currently I can't help you,
but why don't you return to me when you've become a great Hunter and learned how to handle Falcons properly?
Isn't it a beautiful day today?

[Expert Flute Crafter]
The Wolf Flute you have is crafted by myself, with wood.
You can come back here and find me if you lose your Wolf flute!

[Expert Flute Crafter]
The flute can only be crafted by me.
It is just a little matter for me to craft another flute!!

[Expert Flute Crafter]
Do you need anything?
A new Wolf Flute?
Please give me a new Wolf Flute.
No.

[Expert Flute Crafter]
Have you brought all the materials?
Wow! All your materials are not bad!
That's good enough.

[Expert Flute Crafter]
Here's the new Wolf Flute.
Hope you are ready to use it.

[Expert Flute Crafter]
If you want to craft a new Wolf Flute, I need you to bring me ^4d4dff1 Bamboo Cut and 100,000 zeny.^000000

[Expert Flute Crafter]
^4d4dffBamboo Cut can be obtained from Kapha or Karakasa.^000000

[Expert Flute Crafter]
If you do not summon a wolf, then you don't need the Wolf Flute.
You can come back here and find me if you change your mind.
Isn't that right?

[Expert Flute Crafter]
Eeehh? You are not a Ranger?
Then this flute is totally useless for you!
